summary: Verified two features: (1) Attach Progress Note dropdown on Claim Packet detail page works end-to-end. (2) Invoice dates render as mm/dd/yyyy on saved invoices list and view modal.

issues: Many seeded invoices show Invoice Number '—', Patient 'Unknown', and Completed '—'. This is unrelated to the date-format feature but noticeable. Date column correctly shows mm/dd/yyyy.

critical_code_review_comments: Console hydration warning on Claim detail: <span> child of <option> inside select dropdowns (form/invoice/note) — cosmetic but should be cleaned up by removing the span wrapper around option text in Claims.js.
Many invoices have missing patient_id/invoice_number/completed_at rendering '—' — consider adding a filter or seed-data cleanup.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; used existing 3 progress notes and ~25 invoices for Test Patient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 1 (Attach Progress Note): confirmed 4 toolbar controls (claim-pick-form, claim-pick-invoice, claim-pick-note+claim-attach-note, upload document file input). Note dropdown listed 3 notes formatted as 'Test Patient · MM/DD/YYYY'. Selecting a note and clicking add-button appended packet item with source badge 'Progress Note' and filename 'Progress_Note_07-15-2026.pdf'. Feature 2 (Dates mm/dd/yyyy): Saved invoices list Service Date column shows 07/12/2026 for all rows. Invoice view modal header shows 07/12/2026. No yyyy-mm-dd strings found in visible modal/list text.
